projects.name: ExtractMD
projects.summary: Turn webpages, YouTube transcripts and Hacker News threads into Markdown you can keep and reuse.
details: A floating button and keyboard shortcut give quick access to extraction. Supports articles, YouTube transcripts, Hacker News comments and general HTML-to-Markdown conversion.
Includes domain ignore rules, custom selectors, settings import and export, and preservation of code blocks.
I use it every day to save useful content as Markdown.

projects.name: Endless AI Quiz
projects.summary: An endless stream of AI questions, with source-backed explanations and difficulty that adapts as you learn.
details: Curated multiple-choice questions across 14 categories, an Elo-based difficulty model and a weekly challenge. Built with Next.js and Convex, with a related Expo mobile app.
The web app and related mobile app are still in development.
projects.homepageNote: Curated questions across 14 categories, with a weekly challenge and a related mobile app.

projects.name: Omatinta
projects.summary: Generate and upscale wallpapers that match your Omarchy themes, using your own images and references.
details: A community plugin with batch generation across themes, image editing through fal.ai or OpenRouter, and upscaling through fal.ai. Uses your own provider keys.
The plugin is available from its repository. Its submission to the Omarchy plugin marketplace is still open as of 19 October 2026.

projects.name: Theme-aware mpv controls
projects.summary: Playback controls and native menus that follow the active Omarchy theme, including while a video is playing.
details: Adds playback controls, theme-aware native menus, OSD messages and configurable statistics colours. An open player updates its appearance without restarting playback.
Submitted upstream to Omarchy. The pull request is open and unmerged as of 19 October 2026; it is not part of an accepted upstream release.

projects.name: Bundle Icon Generator
projects.summary: Find an icon, adjust its colours and export an app icon bundle with the right sizes and filenames.
details: A local-first utility that searches vetted icon packs and exports assets for Zendesk and other bundle-based platforms. Includes colour and size customisation.

projects.name: Miguel personal style
projects.summary: An interactive field guide to the mikelon visual identity, with typography, colour, components, backgrounds and motion.
details: Browse working examples of the type system, colour palette, reusable interface components, procedural backgrounds and motion studies.
The page includes controls for theme variants, background exports, component states and motion settings.

projects.name: Image Ratio Tool
projects.summary: Check image ratios, preview crops and export images with borders, padding or diagonal cuts.
details: Accepts uploaded, pasted or dropped images. Supports moveable crop previews and expansion to target ratios using solid fills, sampled colours, blur or gradients.
A utility I use regularly when preparing images.

projects.name: Zendesk Admin
projects.summary: Search and manage Zendesk tickets, users and workspace settings directly from Raycast.
details: Search across 14 entity types, including tickets, users, organisations, groups, views and automations. Supports multiple Zendesk instances and direct access to its products.
Includes user, ticket and configuration management workflows.

projects.name: GitHub Auth Switcher
projects.summary: Switch GitHub CLI accounts from the menu bar, with a colour badge for the active account.
details: Imports authenticated accounts from the GitHub CLI and switches between them with one click. Each account can have its own colour badge.
Optional Git profile sync updates the configured username and email when switching accounts. Built as a native macOS app.

projects.name: Simplest Calendar
projects.summary: A minimal calendar in the macOS menu bar, built with SwiftUI.
details: A small native calendar app built with SwiftUI for macOS 14.5 and later.

projects.name: Zendesk applications
projects.summary: A collection of applications built around the daily work of administering a Zendesk workspace.
details: Includes a file previewer with OCR, a ticket-based PDF generator, an AI playground, a reply counter and a task manager.
Other work includes a Zendesk–SAP data validator, call centre monitoring, related-ticket tools and smaller workflow applications. Public source code is not linked for these internal tools.

projects.name: Tesla Robotaxi Analysis
projects.summary: A Python simulation exploring robotaxi adoption and its possible economic and transport effects.
details: Developed a Monte Carlo simulation to assess adoption and economic impact. The thesis considers car ownership, city design, accidents, productivity and pollution.

projects.name: Sustainable Knowledge
projects.summary: A platform I founded, developed and wrote about sustainability and personal growth.
details: Originally created in 2019–2020 and revived in 2025 with a website rebuilt using Cursor. The associated book remains available separately.

homepageHighlights.name: Linux & open source
homepageHighlights.summary: Learning Linux by building for the desktop I use, creating Omarchy plugins and contributing improvements upstream.
details: Omatinta generates theme-matched wallpapers. I’m also developing theme-aware mpv controls for Omarchy, with the upstream pull request open for review. There is more desktop tooling in progress.

workNote: At work, I build AI prototypes and demos, agents, API integrations and internal tools.
